detail.longDescription:
Deezer is more than just a music platform.

It’s a fully personalized listening experience that adapts to you. Deezer is where you can embrace your tastes, turn up the volume, and Live the Music.

With a Deezer Premium plan, you'll get everything you need in one app:

Music you love, made for you
• A massive global catalog with all the tracks you could ever want
• Flow, your infinite, personalized mix of favorites and discoveries
• Smart recommendations that perfectly match your vibe
• Control your music discovery with simple, transparent algorithm controls
• Discover curated playlists for every mood, genre, or season
• Explore Audiobooks*, Radios*, and our growing Podcast catalog, with personalized picks based on your listening

Fun and interactive features
• Deezer Club gives you the chance to win tickets to attend exclusive live events
• Shaker lets you mix playlists with friends and compare your tastes
• Music Quiz tests your music knowledge, play solo or with friends
• SongCatcher helps you find any song playing around you

Customization at your fingertips
• Coming from another music app? Quickly bring all your music to Deezer with Transfer My Music
• Shape your algorithm to find more of the music you love
• Create playlists for every mood, genre, or moment and customize the covers
• Reorganize your Homepage and Library to put your top picks front and center
• Share any song or playlist, even with people who don't use Deezer
• Dive deeper with on-screen Lyrics and translations

And of course, the essentials
• Ad-free listening
• Offline mode lets you download your favorite albums, playlists, and podcasts for when you're low on service
• Unlimited skips and on-demand listening
• Enjoy HiFi sound for lossless listening that's built for audiophiles

Choose your plan:
• Deezer Premium – One Premium account with all our features
• Deezer Duo – Two Premium accounts, one subscription
• Deezer Family – Up to 6 Premium accounts
• Deezer Student – Get all the benefits of Deezer Premium for half the price
• Deezer Free* - Full access to our catalog, with occasional ads and limited features

Take Deezer anywhere
Connect your music to all your favorite devices, at home and on the go:
• Smart speakers — Google Nest, Alexa & Sonos
• On your wrist — Launch the Deezer app on your Galaxy Watch, Fitbit, or any Wear OS device
• In your car — Stream your Flow and Flow Moods with Automotive OS, ad-free, with unlimited skips and HiFi audio
• On Android TV — Stream Flow, track mixes, your playlists, and Library, with synced Lyrics and HiFi audio
Available for Deezer Premium, Deezer Family, Deezer Duo & Deezer Student plans.
